name: pandas-studio
description: Multi-CLI agent team patterns from pandas-studio's YouTube series. Each plugin packages a Claude-as-conductor pattern with companion CLIs (Gemini, Codex) playing specialised roles.

plugins.name: debate-conductor

plugins.name: dev-trio
